messages.subject: Issue with Linear Models no longer working
messages.subject_clean: Issue with Linear Models no longer working
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I have an issue with running a linear model.  It used to work fine and as with other repetitive tasks I have saved the steps and code.

Below are the steps used (had no problem with previous version fo Deducer)
+++++++++++++++++++

Add data set as tab or cvs format.

Go to:

·         Analysis
·         Linear Model
·         Add Fc as outcome
·         FA or Ear as Factor

·         Click continue
·         Click continue

·         Click EXPORT button on right
·         Check Predicted box
·         Click RUN

The data Viewer will have a new column inserted Predicted

Note this is not the completed model.

Copy and paste the code below in the Console window.  Make sure to edit Predicted on 5th line so it is labeled in data Viewer table.

model.lm <- lm(formula=FCmin ~ FA,data=Bats,na.action=na.omit)
Anova(model.lm,type='II')
summary(model.lm)
tmp<-predict(model.lm,Bats)
Bats[names(tmp),"Fcmin_predicted"]<-tmp
rm('tmp')
rm('model.lm')

This will provide predicted values.
+++++++++++++++++++++++

This is not working.

Data set is very simple:
I only needed to "Predict" the Fc for the first row that is not available.
as an FYI the

messages.subject_clean: Issue with Linear Models no longer working
messages.body_plain:
Hi Bruce,

You are modeling FA as a factor. Since “46.3” doesn’t exist in your dataset except for the row with a missing outcome, predict won’t work. Predict can only do predictions on factor levels it has seen before. I’d think about treating FA as numeric in your model.

Best,
Ian

messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

OK I just removed all the old directories related to R and Deducer/JGR
and re-installed R using the most recent version 3.4.2 and installed
Deducer from there.
All is working again.

I will never again simply "UPDATE" packages and always do fresh install.
Bruce
